environment: Node 22; in-memory CaptureStore; no physical receiver

results.name: outcomes distinguish samples, frames and images without claiming a satellite signal
raw bytes are copied before worker transfer and committed with correct counters
sample replay cannot overwrite an earlier live attempt
zero-sample session is saved and exportable without a fake PNG or frame file
a no-image session exports all raw tuning runs and a measured report
report-only export excludes raw bytes but records their saved size
decoded frames and optional image survive finalization and export
quota failure retains the committed prefix and clearly marks the session incomplete
slow storage queue is bounded and reports failure instead of dropping samples
export aborts rather than producing an apparently complete archive with a missing chunk
repeated finalization joins the same promise
imported radio files are not mislabelled as live or silently copied to raw storage
